users.queryPattern: Look up a user by email for login or account pages.

products.queryPattern: Browse a category and filter or sort by price.
SKU lookup for inventory and imports.

orders.queryPattern: Operations view of orders by delivery status.

sharding.orders: hashed userId (keeps one customer's orders on one shard; hashed orderId is the alternative if write heat is uneven)
sharding.products: hashed _id (spreads catalog traffic evenly; category is an alternative if range queries by category must stay targeted)
sharding.daily_sales: hashed _id or ranged date, depending on whether analytics queries are mostly by day or by product

part2.replication: Replica set of 3 nodes per shard (primary + 2 secondaries). Optional multi-region secondaries. readPreference primary for checkout and order status; secondary for analytics.
part2.writeConcern: majority for order-status updates (strong consistency). Analytics upserts may use a lower concern.

daily_sales.queryPattern: Sales totals for a given day or date range.
One product's sales trend over time.
